title: MOSOKO_Russian_Zdravstvuyte_37767d05
style: Upbeat educational pop with a bright, polished production style. The arrangement features a rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming pattern, a clean electric bass playing syncopated lines, and a standard pop drum kit with a crisp snare and steady hi-hats. Male lead vocals are clear and forward in the mix, supported by layered group vocal harmonies in the chorus. A subtle synthesizer provides melodic accents and fills between vocal phrases. The track is in the key of G Major with a tempo of 128 BPM in 4/4 time. Whistling and percussive finger snaps are used as rhythmic embellishments during the intro and transitions.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[acoustic guitar strumming, finger snaps, whistling melody]
(Ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh)
[percussive hits]
(Hup, hup, hey, hup, hup, ho)

[Verse 1]
[acoustic guitar, bass, and light percussion]

[full band enters, driving beat, group vocals]
Zdravstvuyte, privet, kak dela, how are you?
Priyatno, nice to meet you, poka, see you soon
Moscow, learn a new tune

[bass and drums continue, acoustic guitar accents]

[music stops briefly]

Voda, tualet, basic visit
[whistle slide]

[Outro]
[energetic full band, group shouting]
Privet! Spasibo! Pozhaluysta! Do svidaniya!
